items.answer: Almost all the mass is concentrated in the tiny dense nucleus, because it holds the protons and neutrons while electrons have almost no mass.
items.prompt: In one sentence, say where the mass of an atom is concentrated and why.
An element's atoms have three electron shells, with 6 electrons in the outer shell. In which period and group does it sit?

items.answer: Period 3, because it has three electron shells; group 5, because it has 5 electrons in its outer shell.
